acceptance_criteria_coverage.ac_description: Users must be redirected to the Dashboard upon successful login.
Passwords must be masked during entry.
An error message must appear for invalid credentials.
The system must prevent "Brute Force" attacks.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: No test verifies that password masking cannot be bypassed via browser developer tools or script injection.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Attempt to reveal password field value via JavaScript console and ensure it remains masked or inaccessible.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: Edge case of login with email containing special characters or Unicode is not exercised.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Submit login with a valid email containing plus signs, dots, or international characters and verify successful redirect.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: Rate‑limiting behavior under sustained high load is not measured.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Perform load test with a burst of failed login attempts (e.g., 500 requests/second) and confirm that 429 responses are returned after the defined limit.

qa_recommendations: Add a security test to confirm password field cannot be programmatically read or exposed (high risk).
Include email‑format edge case tests with special/Unicode characters to ensure AC‑1 robustness.
Create a performance/security load test for rate limiting to close the high‑risk gap identified for AC‑4.
Automate accessibility verification (TC‑009) where possible using tooling (e.g., axe‑core) to reduce manual effort.
Prioritize execution of high‑risk tests TC‑006, TC‑007, and the new rate‑limiting load test in every regression cycle.
